name: First presented fair value gap (FPFVG)

definitions.definition_text: Give the opening bell a chance, then wait for first presented fair value gap. If price doesn't start booking where a gap can form — or starts sharing the ranges — the scenario would be just wait till 10:00.
conditions: If sharing ranges / no gap forming → wait until 10:00
invalidation: Sharing ranges / no gap forming during early open → defer to 10:00 (stated as scenario)
definitions.timeframe_session_context: NY open / opening range period through 10:00
definitions.variations_note: NY-open FPFVG wait model (official ICT live). Does not fully specify 1m middle-candle-not-9:30 qualification in this excerpt.

definitions.definition_text: First presented fair value gap after first hour's dealing range is broken — that's the one you sell on (lecture example).
definitions.timeframe_session_context: After FHDR break; continuation entry framing
definitions.variations_note: Distinct from NY-open FPFVG-in-opening-range model — KEEP SEPARATE.

definitions.definition_text: Opening range for this model is 9:30–10:00 NY; look for the first fair value gap in that interval. Rule: the FVG cannot form on the 9:30 candle — candle number two of the three-candle FVG cannot be 9:30; earliest candle two is 9:31. Once marked, extend that FPFVG to 3:45 p.m. NY (non-trending / consolidation context).
conditions: Three-candle FVG; middle (candle two) must not be the 9:30 bar (earliest 9:31)
Extend marked FPFVG to 3:45 p.m. NY when not in a one-way trending environment
Needs underlying narrative/bias — not trade the gap alone
Usable as FVG, inversion FVG, or reclaimed FVG
invalidation: FVG whose candle-two is the 9:30 bar → discard; look for next FVG in 9:30–10:00 window
definitions.timeframe_session_context: NY AM opening range 9:30–10:00; RTH examples referenced on 1m
definitions.variations_note: THIRD_PARTY_EXPLANATION (DanDowdTrading summarizing ICT). Confirms prior inferred 9:31 middle-candle rule. Does NOT discuss post-FHDR FPFVG / gap-beyond-FHDR-boundary in this VTT — that remains separate (6DuByzKLDsc).

definitions.definition_text: Recap: between 9:30–10:00 NY look for first presented FVG; usable both directions (FVG / IFVG / reclaimed); candle two cannot form on 9:30 (9:31 earliest); must have bias/reason to target higher or lower — not random longs into the gap.
invalidation: Trading FPFVG without narrative/bias (explicitly discouraged in recap)

definitions.definition_text: Differentiating first presented fair value gap when using opening ranges, not the silver bullet: silver-bullet FPFVG is like the first one that forms after 10:00 inside 10:00–11:00. Opening ranges are defined by 30 minutes (not 15 / not 5); look for displacement inside that OR window. Same 30m application for London (~before 2:00) and NY 9:30–10:00 indices.
conditions: Silver-bullet FPFVG framed as first FVG after 10:00 in the 10:00–11:00 hour (contrasted, not merged)
